body.x: KNOWCK (CEO Kim Jeong-ho, www.knowck.com) showcased its “Cloudcast”, which searches in real time images and videos posted on SNS and transmits them to a display device, at “CES (Consumer Electronic Show) 2016”, the world’s largest IT electronics and tech exhibition, which runs for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th in Las Vegas.

The product is a smart signage solution that is related to three top popular themes: “next-generation display”, “IoT”, and “contents”. It is an integrated platform that changes any display into a smart one, remotely producing, organizing, and managing various media contents via a single set-top box.

In particular, it maximizes convenience by providing various signage apps, so that people can use it according to their particular needs. Also, it can be used for various industries. This is why the product is receiving much attention from various sectors and fields, including advertising businesses, retail stores, franchises, schools, and public institutions.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold 'CES 2016 Review Conference' in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th.
